title: Major disaster declaration DR-4931-MP: Typhoon
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4931-MP, "SUPER TYPHOON BAVI") for MP, dated 2026-08-03, for an incident of type "Typhoon". The incident period began on 2026-07-04 and ended on 2026-07-12. The declaration lists 3 designated areas.
